hypotheses.M1_matched_semantic_route: At matched SAE feature preactivation, surface-positive top-mode mediation exceeds surface-negative mediation by at least 0.15 for both high and random active pairs in at least one basis.
hypotheses.M2_positive_path_specificity: For surface-positive sites, top-mode mediation exceeds norm-matched low-mode mediation by at least 0.20 for both high and random strata in both bases.
hypotheses.M3_activation_match_quality: The absolute standardized preactivation difference between positive and matched-negative sites is at most 0.25 for both strata.
hypotheses.M4_cross_basis_semantic_gap: The positive-minus-matched-negative mediation gap is positive for every category in at least one basis and stratum.
hypotheses.M5_random_positive_generality: Random active surface-positive mediation has category median at least 0.25 in at least one basis.
